risk_summary: The Company presents severe liquidity and solvency risk, including only $65 of cash, over $5.8 million in payables and accrued expenses, an accumulated deficit, recurring losses, and multiple debt defaults. It has no operating history since 2000 and depends on obtaining additional financing to develop its casino project, while also facing litigation from debenture holders and potential related-party obligations.
